answer: A stake-bonded reputation works like a summit climb: each agent locks a refundable deposit before it can trade, and misbehavior forfeits the bond, so spawning a thousand fake identities costs a thousand deposits. Reputation then grows like a vine, slowly, through verified completed work, and cannot be bought or copied. A marble ledger of attestations makes every identity's history public, so a fresh fake with no record earns no trust and no profitable work.
